posts.name: Scholé Learn by Building
posts.tagline: Learning should be more than "click next"
posts.description: Learn by building, on any website, with Scholé by your side. You can read about a tool, watch someone walk through it on YouTube, or ask ChatGPT to explain it. But you won’t properly learn until you build with it yourself. Learn Anywhere mode guides you through using any real tool directly on your screen, adapting tasks and giving visual hints. Everything you learn updates your Scholé knowledge graph and counts towards your lessons. Our thesis? Learn it well enough to use it.

posts.name: NOAN
posts.tagline: The fact layer for your AI agents
posts.description: Your company has thousands of documents, but only one version of the truth. NOAN turns the facts your business has approved such as pricing, positioning, policies, products, customers, and more into a verified, versioned source of truth available through API and MCP. Connect any model, agent, or app and give them all the same company facts, instead of letting each AI interpret your documents differently.

posts.name: CtrlOps 1.0
posts.tagline: Your server. Audited, managed, and deployed with AI.
posts.description: Do you actually know who has access to your servers right now? CtrlOps gives you a security hardening score across 25 checks, a PDF audit report, and fix commands for every issue found. See who can log into every server, revoke access from your whole fleet in one click, and assign any level of roles/access without touching the terminal. Every log file, found and searchable without SSH. Deploy any app from GitHub in minutes. 100% local. Your credentials never leave your machine.

posts.name: Floot MCP
posts.tagline: Build and ship web and mobile apps inside Claude or ChatGPT
posts.description: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.

posts.name: Hookest
posts.tagline: Your swipe file for viral video hooks
posts.description: Hookest tracks the opening seconds of viral TikToks, Reels, and Shorts and makes them searchable with real performance data. Study what’s working in your niche, watch competitors, and bring saved hooks into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini through MCP.

posts.name: Opaline
posts.tagline: PostHog for team Claude Code and Codex sessions.
posts.description: Team-wide, message-level analytics for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Track token cost, time, and skill usage for every single message across your team’s sessions. Catch every “You’re absolutely right” from Claude and every “I know, you f*cking idiot” from a frustrated teammate.

posts.name: minimi 2.0
posts.tagline: AI cat that closes your open loops
posts.description: minimi is personal intelligence that comes to you. We are building a world where before you've said a word, AI already understands you and frees you from the work of managing your own life, so you can spend that time actually living it. Right now, you can adopt AI cats 🐱 on minimi: 1. Cotton captures your personal context so you never explain yourself to AI again. 2. Melody uses this personal context and never lets you miss your commitments More cats 🐈 🐈‍⬛ to come soon...

posts.name: jev-seo
posts.tagline: Free Rust CLI SEO/GEO auditor, no subscription needed
posts.description: Semrush and Ahrefs cost $130+/month for work that's mostly deterministic: crawling a site, checking meta tags, validating schema, checking what AI crawlers can see. jev-seo does that in a free Rust CLI. No subscription, no paid API keys needed for the core checks (crawl, audit, schema, robots, sitemap). Optional Jev-powered semantic scoring (intent classification, GEO/AI-citation scoring) needs a free API key. Also ships as an MCP server for coding agents. cargo install jev-seo

posts.name: Opencontroller by lyzr
posts.tagline: Govern All your agents with a unified control plane
posts.description: AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

posts.name: Maximem Synap
posts.tagline: The fastest, most accurate memory layer for AI agents
posts.description: Maximem Synap is memory and context infrastructure for AI agents, so every conversation does not start from zero. It is the fastest and most accurate memory system on public benchmarks, 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on Locomo, with sub-15ms P75 recall. It handles entity resolution, temporal reasoning, and multi-level scoping automatically, no vector database or ranker to tune. Native across 22 frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, and the Claude Agent SDK. Free tier, no credit card required.

posts.name: Autonomous Product Delivery
posts.tagline: Discover, plan, build, ship, repeat. Product teams run it
posts.description: AI coding agents made code fast; delivery still crawls, because coding is one seat in the product cycle. Autonomous Product Delivery runs the whole loop as one system on your real codebase. Ask a question, or let it suggest the next improvement on its own: The final piece in the loop, the new Discover Mode, researches your analytics, tickets, calls, and code, then the system plans, builds, verifies, and hands your engineers a review-ready PR. Every merge makes it smarter.

posts.name: NotchPop
posts.tagline: The Dynamic Island your MacBook notch was missing
posts.description: NotchPop turns your MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: music, a file shelf, clipboard history, focus timer, calendar, weather, AI coding stats and revenue. Works on Macs without a notch too. Native SwiftUI, $3.99 once, 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech models
posts.tagline: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
posts.description: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.

posts.name: Storytailor®
posts.tagline: A personal world built around your child’s imagination
posts.description: The rebuilt Storytailor turns children’s ideas and drawings into recurring characters and illustrated stories for families, educators and care teams. Read or listen together, explore unfamiliar words with Wonder Words™, and keep going with off-screen activities. Create stories around everyday questions, big changes or pure silliness, with characters that reflect the child’s world. Educator stories include lesson plans. Your first two stories are free.

posts.name: IntellAgents.io
posts.tagline: One AI agent for every call, chat, and DM
posts.description: Most businesses juggle a different tool for every channel — one for phone support, another for WhatsApp, another for the website chatbot. IntellAgents replaces all of it with one AI agent that answers inbound calls, makes outbound calls, and handles WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and your website — live 24/7, in up to 36 languages, from a single knowledge base you set up once.

posts.name: Harness Manager
posts.tagline: Your AI coding stack manager, all in one place
posts.description: Harness Manager is the App Store and control center for AI coding harnesses on Mac. Discover, install and update tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and more. Automatically detect what’s already installed, manage MCP servers and AI skills, check versions and paths, and diagnose broken installations or configuration issues. Your entire AI coding stack, finally in one place.

posts.name: Parall
posts.tagline: Run multiple instances of the same app on your Mac
posts.description: Parall lets you run multiple instances of macOS apps and turn websites into Web App Shortcuts with unique Dock icons, custom data paths, HOME overrides, environment variables, Dock effects, file/folder shortcuts, and command-line launchers.

posts.name: LockLines
posts.tagline: Design Mac lock screen messages that fit
posts.description: LockLines is a macOS app for designing plain-text lock screen messages that fit the small message area.

posts.name: Subscrr
posts.tagline: Build a financial plan and ask what to cancel
posts.description: Two new things, both in beta. Financial plan: describe your money in plain words and Subscrr lays your year out month by month. Test a purchase or a month without income before you commit, then compare the plan with what actually happened. Subscrr AI: ask where you are overpaying and get findings with the amount each one saves. It opens the subscription so you can cancel, it never does it for you. Still tracks what every subscription really costs per day, month and year.

posts.name: ChoreDivider
posts.tagline: Split chores by what each of you actually minds doing
posts.description: Every chore app asks how hard a chore is, once, for everyone. ChoreDivider asks each of you, in private: how draining is this for you? Ratings stay sealed until everyone is done. Then it deals each day so minutes stay even over 14 days and nobody gets the chore they dread. Every chore says, why it landed with you. No points, no leaderboard.

posts.name: Bitrise Build Hub
posts.tagline: GitHub Actions runners that build 2x faster for your agents
posts.description: Coding agents push more code, so your CI runs more builds than ever. GitHub's runners are slow, so every extra build sits in the queue and your team waits with it. Bitrise Build Hub runs those builds on the newest Apple Silicon and high-core Linux instead: 54% faster on iOS, 31% on Android. PRs come back in minutes, and your app ships sooner. You keep GitHub Actions. Changing one line in your workflow is all it takes to run on the best runners made for mobile.

posts.name: AIMapy - AI Map
posts.tagline: AI Travel Map and Planner
posts.description: AIMapy is an AI travel map & planner that creates personalized routes in 30 seconds. Plan trips with friends and discover top attractions, restaurants, shops, and events tailored to your interests. Explore 1.5M+ places, including recommendations from UNESCO, Michelin Guide, National Geographic, and more

posts.name: ByDesign AI Canvas
posts.tagline: The first planner that thinks with you.
posts.description: Three things landed in ByDesign this month. An AI that takes any goal and builds the real plan. Steps, resources, courses, all scheduled across your year. An assistant you can just talk to. Reshuffle the week, find time for tasks, schedule meetings on the go. And a canvas that's flexible to how you plan. See the next ten days, a quarter, the whole year, or whatever view makes sense to you.

posts.name: aso.best
posts.tagline: ASO for both stores, in a chat instead of a dashboard
posts.description: I built this while trying to rank my own apps. What wore me down was the clicking: filters, exports, then pasting a subtitle into App Store Connect once per language. So aso.best is mostly a chat. Ask what a competitor ranks for, which keywords you lost this week, or to translate your listing into all 39 App Store locales. It runs the read and writes the result back to App Store Connect and Play. The same 36 tools run in your own Claude or Cursor over MCP. Every number is the store's own.

posts.name: Daywatch
posts.tagline: Shift scheduling that understands plain English
posts.description: Building a staff schedule manually takes hours. Getting it right, covering every shift while respecting labor rules, certifications, and individual contracts, often takes much longer. Daywatch does it in one click. Describe your rules in plain language. Workers share their preferences the same way. The AI reads everything and generates a fully optimized schedule adapted to your team's exact needs, automatically. Built for any team that runs on shifts.

posts.name: OsmO
posts.tagline: Personal assistants that answer and make calls for you
posts.description: Assistants by OsmO are AI phone agents that screen calls, transfer urgent ones, collect requests, and share call summaries. They also make outbound calls, navigate phone menus, and handle recurring calls. Available on iPhone and Android with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: InitSignal
posts.tagline: Real-time iOS and macOS apps downloads and revenue tracking
posts.description: InitSignal provides real-time insights and notifications about new users and paid apps' revenue, helping you track your app downloads instantly.

posts.name: Dezycro -  The Coding Agent Harness
posts.tagline: Stop burning tokens on code your agent broke
posts.description: Stop burning tokens and engineering hours on code your agent hallucinated. Dezycro is the true harness for autonomous coding agents. By utilizing knowledge graphs and logic verification, Dezycro ensures your agents understand real system boundaries and ship working features the first time with zero source code access required.

posts.name: Tincan
posts.tagline: A group chat for AI assistants
posts.description: Connect personal AI assistants in shared rooms to coordinate plans, send files to each other, and collaborate on shared docs. Multiplayer AI means your agents are proactively build working relationships, regardless of where they live. Tincan is the place where it happens. To get started, paste this into your agent, no signup needed: Set up Tincan using https://gotincan.com/start.md. Coordinate with other assistants in the background, handle replies, and notify me only for results, or decisions.

posts.name: TurnPanel
posts.tagline: A local-first AI workspace built for getting work done
posts.description: Your work is scattered across AI chats, email, calendars, meeting notes and coding agents. TurnPanel brings it into one private, local AI workspace. Unlike Grok Bot and Muse, which run agents in their cloud, TurnPanel runs them on your desktop, where you own your chats, files, memory and history, and control what your agents do. It's self-evolving: your memory, skills and workflows get better the more you use it. Run local models, bring your own providers, or both. Free on macOS and Windows.

posts.name: Zrevick
posts.tagline: The business operating system for AI-native startups
posts.description: Zrevick is the business operating system for AI-native startups. Build with Claude Code or Codex, then launch websites, find leads, run outreach, publish content, support customers, and schedule agents—all from one connected workspace. Unlimited access is $34.

posts.name: misapuntes.co
posts.tagline: Turn your own notes into an AI tutor
posts.description: misapuntes.co turns photos of your class notes into a personal AI tutor. Upload notes by date and subject, then ask questions, research the web, and generate interactive quizzes or flashcards. Unlike generic AI study tools, it keeps your own material at the center, helping you review what you actually learned and turn saved notes into active practice.

posts.name: RUUN
posts.tagline: A Tor-based browser with a separate direct mode
posts.description: RUUN is a Tor Browser-based browser built around one simple idea: stop switching between browsers. It gives you two completely separate modes — Tor Mode for Tor-routed, hardened browsing and Direct Mode for normal persistent browsing with its own profile, cookies, bookmarks, logins, and history. RUUN also brings back a classic early-web UI instead of another modern browser interface.

posts.name: Workshop Compass
posts.tagline: The right product workshop, at the right stage, in order
posts.description: Describe your product challenge in your own words and let AI pre-fill the context, or answer 5 quick questions manually. Workshop Compass then recommends the right sequence from 75 product workshops, based on your stage, team, needs and timeframe. Each workshop includes a ready-to-use FigJam board, step-by-step facilitation guide and worked example. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Flexaura
posts.tagline: Build AI agents your customers will love.
posts.description: Build AI agents with real knowledge base retrieval, custom workflows, and human handoff — deployed across web chat and email. No code required.

posts.name: Lyssna MCP
posts.tagline: Unlock your research inside your AI tools
posts.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or Cursor to Lyssna to query your studies, get answers grounded in participant data. Sign up for free.

posts.name: DealKeep
posts.tagline: Stop losing money on lifetime deals you already own
posts.description: Bought a pile of AppSumo/StackSocial/PitchGround lifetime deals and lost track? DealKeep imports every purchase, alerts you before refund windows close, kills duplicate buys, and flags tools whose founders go quiet — so your LTD stack stops turning into money you forgot you spent. Free Forever to start; one-time plans, no subscription.

posts.name: Sidenet AI
posts.tagline: Infrastructure to make your product AI native
posts.description: Build agents, workflows and networks with auth, memory and orchestration built in. Access any LLM worldwide (605 models, 60+ providers). Connect your APIs or MCP servers in a few clicks, or use 1,000+ integrations. Drill into traces, test against datasets before you ship, get outputs scored by LLM judges. Track cost per model, agent, task or customer, and monetise. Embed an AI workspace inside your app with a few lines of code where users can ask, schedule, automate anything.

posts.name: Valedo
posts.tagline: Shared lists for everything your family needs and wants
posts.description: Valedo is one place for everything your family needs, wants, or plans to buy. Create and share shopping lists, wishlists, and everyday lists across iPhone, Android, and web. Add items by typing, voice, or scanning a paper list, organize them by category, set reminders, and start quickly with ready-made lists for groceries, school, travel, pets, and more. Everything stays synced, so everyone knows what’s needed and what’s already done.

posts.name: QuickLook Pro
posts.tagline: Preview 300+ file formats directly in Finder
posts.description: Preview Markdown, SQLite, ZIP, JSON, CSV, source code, logs and 300+ other formats with the spacebar. Select a file. Press Space. See what's inside, without opening another app. Native. Private. No account. No subscription.

posts.name: Starlane
posts.tagline: The endless lane that makes you swear, then hit Launch again
posts.description: StarLane is a tiny ship on floating platforms in the dark. You steer. You jump the gaps. You clip a barrier you swear wasn’t there. The score is distance in meters. The king sits at the top of the board until someone goes further. Practice is free and still somehow rude. Paid packs start at $1 when you’re ready to mean it. There is no prize. Just the lane, your last crash, and the quiet urge to try one more run.

posts.name: HarperFlow
posts.tagline: Turn your company blog into an AI-search growth engine
posts.description: Your buyers stopped Googling. Now they ask AI who to buy from — and AI answers with names, not links. HarperFlow puts you on that shortlist. Not a writer — an editorial operation: it finds what your buyers ask AI, researches each article with 8–12 dated sources, fact-checks every claim, and publishes into Webflow, WordPress or Shopify with the FAQs, tables and JSON-LD engines quote. 5–30 articles a month in your voice, with veto before it goes live. 7-day trial: 3 articles; card required.

posts.name: Reloop Temp Email Checker
posts.tagline: Block disposable emails & protect your sender reputation
posts.description: Free temp email checker. Paste an email, Instantly see if it’s a known throwaway (Mailinator, Yopmail, Temp-Mail, and ~210k domains), a role address, or has MX with no signup, no API key, and no SMTP probing. Free public API for signup protection.

posts.name: SnS
posts.tagline: AI Chief of Staff for your business
posts.description: Founders spend the week asking 'where are we on this?' SnS answers before they ask. You don't need standups or 10 boards to update just to know what your team is doing. It should be frictionless. It should be as easy as sending a SMS. As easy as- SnS. SnS- An AI meant to elevate, not eliminate.

posts.name: Lotiqlab
posts.tagline: Create, edit and export animations for free
posts.description: A free browser-based motion editor for creating, editing and exporting animations. Create animations from scratch, bring designs from Figma, use presets, edit layers, preview your work and export to GIF, MP4, PNG or Lottie. No expensive software...No complicated setup...100% Free Built to make motion more accessible to everyone.

posts.name: Veil
posts.tagline: Turn your AirPods into privacy shield
posts.description: Veil uses AirPods head tracking to blur your Mac when you turn away, trigger apps with head gestures, and animate a notch pet. Download Veil for Mac. Along with it we have a lovely pet that will give you company on your notch, a pet that follows your head.

posts.name: FacelessReels
posts.tagline: Create faceless videos with control over every scene
posts.description: Turn an idea or script into a faceless video with AI visuals, narration and captions. Review the script, refine individual scenes and export your reel as an MP4. FacelessReels keeps the creative decisions in your hands, from the first draft to the final video.

posts.name: CinemaKit + CinemaKit Studio
posts.tagline: Shoot true RAW. Finish locally in your browser.
posts.description: CinemaKit captures real Bayer sensor data for true RAW video, not simulated RAW or a filter. Shoot RAW, Log and HEVC on iPhone and Android, then process footage locally in CinemaKit Studio. Grade, stabilize, create slow motion, generate depth maps and export in your browser with no uploads or account required. Studio is free and supports CKRAW, MLV, MCRAW, CinemaDNG, ProRes, HEVC, XAVC and experimental BRAW.

posts.name: ihateimg
posts.tagline: Free, private image editing tools that run in your browser
posts.description: ihateimg.cv is a suite of web-based image processing tools designed for privacy and convenience. It enables users to perform common image manipulations like format conversion (including HEIC), compression, resizing, and cropping entirely within their browser, without uploading files to a server. This approach ensures data privacy, faster processing for smaller files. It is ideal for individuals, professionals, and businesses

posts.name: MVP.ai
posts.tagline: AI companions with personality, bonding, and progression
posts.description: MVP.ai is a character-driven AI companion built around personality, bonding, and progression. Instead of a generic chat interface, users interact with a virtual companion that has its own personality and develops through continued interaction. Core features include distinct personality archetypes, a Bond Leveling System, and Quick Sparks for spontaneous conversations. MVP.ai is designed to make AI feel more expressive and personal without replacing human connection.

posts.name: Flinder
posts.tagline: Things to do, picked for the time and weather
posts.description: Flinder helps you decide what to do when you have free time and no plan. It checks the local time and weather, then suggests ideas one at a time: bowling or karaoke on a rainy evening, parks and ice cream on a sunny afternoon, bars and nightclubs late at night. Tap an idea to see places nearby. New in 4.0: set any city to see ideas for its local time and weather before a trip, and save places in a folder per city. No account, no ads. Free, with an optional Pro (Lifetime!) upgrade.

posts.name: Lumi
posts.tagline: Your AI finally remembers you. No more starting from zero.
posts.description: Lumi gives your AI persistent memory across chats. Start a new Claude or ChatGPT session and it already knows your project, preferences, and history. No re-explaining. No copy-pasting old threads. Store wide, retrieve narrow: upload docs and PDFs, Lumi indexes everything but surfaces only what's relevant per prompt like personal RAG, no setup needed. Cuts token usage on long projects without losing context. Free to start.

posts.name: Macky
posts.tagline: Use Mac terminal from iPhone
posts.description: Macky is a secure, real-time mobile client that lets you access your Mac's screen and terminal from your iPhone. Supports Zsh, Bash, Claude Code, Codex, and full remote desktop over end-to-end encrypted WebRTC.

posts.name: Workotrack
posts.tagline: See your people on the course, live, with just a link
posts.description: Workotrack puts every participant of a race, sportive or century on one live map. Participants share their position from the phone app. Everyone else opens a link: no app, no account. Positions snap to the course, so families see distance done, distance left, speed and an arrival estimate that accounts for the climbs ahead. Organisers create an event from a GPX in ten minutes and get a join code for the race pack. It runs alongside your timing, it does not replace it. Free while in pilot.

posts.name: Find Your Next Opportunity · TalentApply
posts.tagline: Find Jobs That Fit You.
posts.description: Your entire job search, powered by AI. Discover personalized opportunities from 300,000+ active jobs, with 4,000+ added daily. Improve your CV, check your job match, prepare for interviews, create stronger applications, and track everything in one place.

posts.name: Arcentry - 3D infrastructure diagrams
posts.tagline: Create beautiful 3D diagrams for cloud and open source
posts.description: Arcentry is back. Create beautiful 2D and 3D cloud infrastructure diagrams, with 700+ new components for AI, Cloud and Agents. Import Terraform, OpenTofu or CloudFormation, describe your stack via AI chat, or build manually. Generated diagrams remain fully editable and can be embedded as interactive 3D views or connected to live operational data through the API.

posts.name: Vedlikeholdsloggen
posts.tagline: Home maintenance for Norway, every task cites its source
posts.description: A maintenance reminder app for Norwegian homes. It knows what a house, a cabin or a flat needs, and when: the outdoor tap closes in October, not July. Every one of its 45 tasks names the Norwegian authority the advice came from, and links to the page. One notification, Saturday at 09:00, before the deadline rather than on it. A logbook with photos, exportable as PDF or as a backup file you carry to a new phone. No account, no login, no tracking. Norwegian only, iOS only.

posts.name: Tola
posts.tagline: A to-do list for minimalists.
posts.description: Your attention is yours. Tola is built to respect and protect it. Focus on Today, save the rest for Later, and set reminders only when you choose. No engagement nudges. No AI for the sake of AI. Manage tasks offline, without an account.

posts.name: Tambola Number Caller App
posts.tagline: Automatic Tambola & Housie number caller with audio & board
posts.description: Host your Tambola and Housie games hassle-free with Tambola Number Caller App. No need to manually pick or announce numbers—our smart app handles automatic caller voice announcements in multiple speeds, keeps a clear visual board, and tracks game history in real time. Perfect for family gatherings, party games, and community events. Features flexible auto-call delays, customizable audio options, clean UI, and offline support for seamless group entertainment anytime, anywhere!

posts.name: Assemblix
posts.tagline: Chat agents as workflows - with voice & avatars
posts.description: Assemblix is a visual engine for building conversational AI agents. Design the whole chat as a graph - branching logic, any LLM (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), knowledge bases, and typed state that remembers context across turns. posts.tagline: Interview prep and fandom quizzies graded by AI
posts.description: Every quiz app gives you four options to pick from, and recognizing the right answer is much easier than knowing it. Nadir has no multiple choice. You type your answer in plain text and an LLM grades it 0-100 against a reference solution, then tells you what you missed. I built this to prepare myself for technical interviews but the trivia topics turned out to be more popular among my friends, so Nadir has more than just technical topics - there's trivia about TV shows, movies and books too.

posts.name: Superlist for ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Turn conversations into tasks. Manage them right in ChatGPT.
posts.description: Turn a ChatGPT conversation into work you can follow through on. Superlist for ChatGPT lets you create tasks and lists, find what's due, and update your work without leaving the chat. Turn meeting notes into action items, reschedule a busy day, set recurring tasks, update notes and priorities, and check things off. Manage personal and shared lists, assign tasks, and share lists with existing collaborators—all through conversation.

posts.name: Rill
posts.tagline: Get paid by agents.
posts.description: Rill lets software companies get paid by AI agents and lets agents pay under a budget. Accept: create a gate URL, enable MPP and x402, and charge agents without needing access to their API.

posts.name: Evalia
posts.tagline: Hire Smarter. Decide Faster.
posts.description: Evalia is the all-in-one AI hiring platform. Screen CVs, run skills assessments, and conduct AI video interviews with advanced anti-cheat proctoring.

posts.name: builtwithlaya
posts.tagline: Unofficial gallery of public Laya decision-model builds
posts.description: An unofficial catalog of 22 public builds using ConvAI's open Laya decision model. Not their Hugging Face repo, not their official demo, and not affiliated with ConvAI. Browse by machine: Apple Silicon, Neural Engine, browser, or GPU. Each card leaves this site. Four free walkthroughs point at the authors' cards. Figures stay the author's. We do not re-run them. Send a public link; a person checks it before it is listed.

posts.name: Spiral DJ
posts.tagline: Plan and stress-test your DJ sets in your browser
posts.description: Spiral DJ helps you build the night before you play it. Analyse your music library for BPM, key and energy, shape your set, explore alternative routes and check transitions. Stress-test the full journey, then export the running order to your DJ software. Record what you actually played and rediscover forgotten gems. Your audio stays on your device, with analysis running locally in your browser. Start free with 500 tracks. Upgrade to Pro for professional exports and gig history.

posts.name: VICE Platform - Public Beta
posts.tagline: Secure the product you are building
posts.description: VICE audits your web app the way an attacker would: leaked secrets in your bundles, Supabase RLS misconfigurations, exposed APIs, weak headers and infrastructure.... The engine is open source and free today, as a CLI or a GitHub Action. The hosted Platform adds the full loop: verify your domain, run a full audit, get findings with evidence, apply a suggested fix, then retest to confirm it's gone.

posts.name: ATHELING
posts.tagline: Would you have won in 1066?
posts.description: Atheling is a text-based, single-player historical strategy game where you rule England through some of its most important moments. Start in 1066 and see if you could have done better than Harold. Manage your dynasty, make political decisions, fight wars, deal with succession, and watch history change around you. The game uses real historical characters and events as a starting point, but every campaign can play out differently depending on the choices you make.

posts.name: Waypoint
posts.tagline: Your next trip, figured out.
posts.description: Waypoint discovers your upcoming holiday opportunities and recommends destinations based on your timing, budget, interests, season and much more. Give it as much or as little context as you want. It figures out your next trip.

posts.name: Jev ZenFeed
posts.tagline: Active Noise Cancellation for your eyes 🎧👁️
posts.description: Active Noise Cancellation for your eyes. 🎧👁️ Just like ANC headphones mute street roar, ZenFeed automatically collapses toxic drama, ragebait, and scams on your social feeds using natural language AI. ✨ Highlights: • ⚡ Sub-200ms & Zero-CLS (no page jumping) • 🎯 Natural language filtering (no brittle regex) • 🔒 100% BYOK & local privacy (no tracking servers) • 🧘 Zen Oasis: Replace noise with mindfulness 100% Free & open source. Reclaim your attention!

posts.name: BroomCleaner
posts.tagline: Privacy cleanup that keeps your browser fast
posts.description: Clear cookies, cache, history & passwords automatically. Stay private, stay fast. Broom Cookie Cleaner runs on smart automation Profiles with 5 triggers: - On browser exit - On a fixed schedule - After inactivity - On Profile switch - On tab close Choose what to clean (cookies, history, cache, downloads, passwords) per Profile. Built on years of experience in privacy & security tooling — works across Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.

posts.name: GlanceVitals
posts.tagline: Private Apple Health widgets for iPhone and iPad.
posts.description: Build customizable Apple Health widgets for your iPhone Home Screen and Lock Screen. See steps, sleep, heart rate, HRV and more at a glance.

posts.name: Orai Tau
posts.tagline: Valandinė orų prognozė, radaras ir įspėjimai
posts.description: Orų prognozė Lietuvoje: valandinė prognozė, kritulių radaras, oficialūs LHMT įspėjimai, temperatūra, vėjas, drėgmė ir oro kokybė. Duomenys Vilniui, Kaunui, Klaipėdai ir kitur.

posts.name: Find The Pieces: Puzzle Tales
posts.tagline: Relaxing Storybook Puzzles
posts.description: Discover charming pictures one piece at a time in Find The Pieces: Puzzle Tales! Drag, match, and merge scattered pieces to complete beautiful storybook scenes. Meet adorable animals, explore colorful worlds, and enjoy relaxing puzzles designed for players of all ages.

posts.name: OpenCraft - ChatGPT on Open Models
posts.tagline: Co-Work for your team for up to 10x less using any model
posts.description: Chat that makes real files: slide decks, docs, video, charts and 3D models — on the best models from any provider. Pay per use, with a receipt on every turn.

posts.name: Billmint
posts.tagline: Free invoice generator — GST, VAT & Sales Tax, no signup
posts.description: Billmint is a free invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses anywhere in the world. Fill a simple form, get a live preview, add your logo, and download a clean PDF — no signup, no watermark, no monthly fee. It gets tax right for your country automatically: GST (CGST/SGST/IGST) for India, VAT for the UK & EU, Sales Tax for the US, and more — each with the correct currency. Built solo, in public. Free forever.

posts.name: Art Atelier
posts.tagline: 3D drawing and lighting studies
posts.description: Orbit a studio lamp around a 3D planar head, skull, hand, or a classical bust. Start from a preset (Rembrandt, split, butterfly, rim) or drag the key light anywhere, then turn the form to match your model's pose. Posterize the shading into 2-5 flat values, like a notan, so the big value shapes stop hiding behind gradients. Everything renders on-device, so it works offline. Free to try. One payment unlocks every subject, no subscription.

posts.name: NowSense Visual Calendar
posts.tagline: See the next thing on your Lock Screen - live countdown.
posts.description: You check the clock. You open the calendar. You still lose track of how long until the next thing. NowSense puts that next thing on your Lock Screen with a live countdown. Pickup Kids. Lunch. The meeting after this one. How long until the next thing, right on your lock screen. How it works: Lock Screen - Live Activity countdown on the Lock Screen Sync Calendars (pick which calendars on your iPhone feed your timeline) Up Next Home Screen widgets - medium, large, and a small dial

posts.name: Waltro
posts.tagline: Understand your crypto wallet in plain English
posts.description: Most crypto tools are built for people who already understand crypto. Waltro isn't. Paste any wallet address and get a clear, jargon-free explanation of what actually happened — no accounts needed to try it. Built for the millions of crypto newcomers who've stared at a confusing transaction and had no idea what it meant. Free to use, with optional accounts for saved wallets, weekly digests, and portfolio tracking. Also flags known scam-token patterns automatically.

posts.name: Underpeaks
posts.tagline: Design your data model. Get a real Flutter and Next.js app.
posts.description: Most headless CMS tools stop at an API and a web admin. Underpeaks generates a real Flutter app and a real Next.js app from the same schema. Runs on Supabase, Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, or Firebase. Self-host it free, or let us host it.

posts.name: GIF Decider · the right GIF, decided
posts.tagline: Perfect GIF for every moment
posts.description: Describe the moment. Jev reads it, searches, judges every candidate, and hands you the three best GIFs, stickers, memes and clips.

posts.name: Klooset
posts.tagline: AI stylist for fashion commerce
posts.description: Klooset adds an AI stylist to any fashion store. Shoppers try clothes on virtually, get their size, find colors that suit them and build full outfits, all in one conversation. EU-first, GDPR-native, one script tag to install. Free plan available.

posts.name: Cue for Monitors
posts.tagline: Save your window layout as a scene, restore it in one key
posts.description: Cue saves how your windows sit across every display as a scene and puts them back with one keystroke.

posts.name: Krova
posts.tagline: Tech for Citizens
posts.description: Krova is a platform designed to empower users through high-performance and sustainable technology. Our "Tech for Citizens" approach aims to provide robust tools that create real value in daily use, without compromising on the project's quality or ambition. The goal is to build a long-lasting solution that will evolve alongside our users' needs.

posts.name: Doodle It - Scratch Art Paper
posts.tagline: Relaxing drawing app for creative downtime
posts.description: Doodle It is a relaxing drawing app with scratch art reveals, calming creative play, and smooth offline doodling sessions for stress-free creativity. Why You’ll Love Doodle It: ・ Scratch the screen to reveal stunning colorful backgrounds underneath. ・ Add neon glow effects for extra magical touches. ・ Turn your drawings into short videos and share it with friends. ・ Save your masterpieces to your device or share them easily on social media. ・ Trace the shape on screen to draw.

posts.name: Jr-Arch
posts.tagline: Coding agent in your repo. Your models, agents & rules.
posts.description: Jr-Arch is an open-source coding agent built to live inside your repository. Bring your own model and API key instead of being locked to a single provider. Agents, rules, personas, and guardrails are plain files in `.gitagent/`, making them readable, version-controlled, and reviewable. Built around the OpenGAP protocol, with support for major model providers and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, zero runtime dependencies, and no telemetry.

posts.name: OpenScout
posts.tagline: Turn Reddit into your growth channel
posts.description: Reddit is where Google and AI go for answers. OpenScout finds the threads your buyers are in, writes posts and replies, and gets you mentioned. Start building a customer pipeline from Reddit.

posts.name: TechoStop
posts.tagline: Client Portal for Indian Freelancers
posts.description: TechoStop is client portal software for freelancers and agencies in India - manage clients, employees, projects, GST invoices, tasks, and meetings in one branded portal. Plans from ₹299/month.

posts.name: CodeInk
posts.tagline: One desktop workspace for all your coding agents
posts.description: CodeInk brings Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and ACP agents into one open-source desktop workspace. Organize projects and sessions, watch tools and edits in real time, and use your existing agent installs and accounts. Downloads are live for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

posts.name: Redirect & Header Checker
posts.tagline: See every redirect hop and response header in one click
posts.description: A free Chrome extension that shows every redirect between the URL you typed and the page you landed on, with status codes, timing and protocol for each hop, plus the final page's indexing, caching and security headers. Nothing leaves your browser.

posts.name: Notch Plus
posts.tagline: Your MacBook's Notch Made More Useful, 22 instant tools.
posts.description: Notch Plus brings analytics, revenue, traffic, prompter, stocks, timers, files, notes, clipboard, system stats, and more to the space around your MacBook's notch — always just a hover away.

posts.name: Resillator
posts.tagline: Describe your business. AI builds and runs your workspace.
posts.description: CRM, projects, invoicing, docs and voice agents in one workspace. Describe your business in a sentence and it builds the whole thing in about a minute — then AI agents actually run it: select any records, hand them to an agent, and it works through them. From $19/mo, priced per workspace, not per seat. 14 days free, no card.

posts.name: Hands for Agents
posts.tagline: Your AI agent can now order a physical object
posts.description: An MCP server and REST API in front of a mechanical engineer in the EU. Your agent asks for a quote; a person answers within 24 hours with one fixed price, then makes it, documents it and ships it. No account, no crypto.

posts.name: Griddots
posts.tagline: A color-link puzzle where every cell must be filled
posts.description: Griddots is a color-link logic puzzle built around one simple rule: connect every matching pair and leave no cell empty. Classic Mode challenges you to plan paths without crossing, while Junction Mode introduces special cells where selected paths can cross, creating new solving strategies. Progress from Easy to Expert, explore themed Starmap packs, and take on three fresh Daily Challenges every day.

posts.name: UseWok
posts.tagline: Done-for-You SaaS Presence for Search & AI | UseWo
posts.description: Stop letting competitors become the answer. UseWok turns AI visibility from another job into work already done. We build the public footprint AI assistants can use to discover, understand, and mention your SaaS—without handing you a single task. No scores to decode. No strategy to execute. No accounts to connect. We handle the complex work end to end and document every result. You build the product. We make it harder for AI to overlook. $59 once.
